title: Made in God's Image
summary: Every person has value because God made people in His image. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 1:26-31 and look for how this passage teaches: Every person has value because God made people in His image.

tell_it: God made people different from everything else He created. People can know God, reflect His care, and treat others with dignity.
understand_it: Every person has value because God made people in His image. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Made in God's Image reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Identity matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Made in God's Image shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Every person has value because God made people in His image.
teen_explanation: Made in God's Image gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that every person has value because God made people in His image. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Every person has value because God made people in His image.
God made the world and it belongs to Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when identity is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Why should we treat people with respect?
choices: People are made in God's image
quiz_questions.answer: People are made in God's image
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: People are made in God's image. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that every person has value because God made people in His image.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 1:27 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Made in God's Image?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Image Bearer Mirror
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Every person has value because God made people in His image.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Made in God's Image. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
